# 0 Set up environment
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
```

# Missingness proportion among SNPs
```{r}
# Load table
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
Missingness_Prop <- read.delim("Missingness_Prop.txt", header=F, sep=" ")
colnames(Missingness_Prop) <- c("POS", "Missingness_Proportion")

# Set your window size in base pairs
window_size <- 50000


# Create a window index for each row
Missingness_Prop_binned <- Missingness_Prop |>
  mutate(window = floor(POS / window_size) * window_size) |>
  group_by(window) |>
  summarize(mean_missingness = mean(Missingness_Proportion))

# Plot: one point per window for mean missingness
ggplot(Missingness_Prop_binned, aes(x = window + window_size/2, y = mean_missingness)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic Position",
    y = "Mean Missingness per Window",
    title = paste("Missingness Across Genome (", window_size, "bp windows)", sep="")
  )
```
